scenes.basis: 8:1 "he came down from the mountain" - the mountain is unnamed; the leper is healed there
8:5 "When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him"
8:14 "When Jesus came into Peter's house" - Peter's house in Capernaum (Mark 1:29), no movement away
8:18 "he gave the order to depart to the other side"; 8:24 "a violent storm came up on the sea" - the sea by Capernaum
8:28 "into the country of the Gergesenes" - the text names no graphed place (Gergesa has no id)
